children.children: 3) Fermentation of glucose by yeast yields

Yeast performs anaerobic respiration, also known as fermentation. In the absence of oxygen, yeast breaks down glucose into ethanol (an alcohol) and carbon dioxide, yielding a net total of 2 ATP (energy) molecules per glucose molecule.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 4) Process of breakdown of glucose into pyruvate occur in

The first step of cellular respiration is glycolysis, where a glucose molecule is broken down into two molecules of pyruvate. This specific process occurs in the cytoplasm of the cell, regardless of whether the cell is undergoing aerobic or anaerobic respiration.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 5) The process by which blood is cleared of metabolic waste in case of kidney failure is
Hemodialysis is the medical procedure used to artificially filter metabolic wastes, excess water, and toxins from the blood when a patient's kidneys can no longer perform this function naturally.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 6) Which of the following event doesn't occur during photosynthesis
(b) reduction of carbon dioxide to carbohydrate
(c) oxidation of carbon to carbon dioxide
(d) conversion of light energy into chemical energy
✓ (c) oxidation of carbon to carbon dioxide

During photosynthesis, plants take in carbon dioxide and reduce it to form carbohydrates (glucose). The oxidation of carbon to carbon dioxide is a process that occurs during cellular respiration, not photosynthesis.

children.children: 7) Which is the correct sequence of parts in human elementary canal
(a) mouth- stomach -small intestine- oesophagus- large intestine
(c) mouth- oesophagus- stomach- large intestine- small intestine

Food is ingested through the mouth, travels down the muscular tube called the oesophagus, enters the stomach for digestion, moves into the small intestine where the majority of digestion and nutrient absorption occurs, and finally passes into the large intestine where water is absorbed before elimination.

children.children: 8) A converging lens has focal length of 12 cm. Calculate at what distance should the object be placed from the lens so that it forms an image at 48 centimetre on the other side of the lens

We use the thin lens formula: 1/f = 1/v - 1/u. For a converging (convex) lens, f = +12 cm. Since the image is real, v = +48 cm. 1/12 = 1/48 - 1/u => 1/u = 1/48 - 4/48 = -3/48 = -1/16. So u = -16 cm. The physical distance is 16 cm.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 9) No deviation of light takes place from
By definition, any ray of light that passes directly through the optical centre of a thin lens emerges parallel to its incident direction and without any lateral deviation.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 10) Two thin lenses of power + 3.5 diopter and -2.5 diopter are placed in contact the focal length of the lens combination is
The total power P = P1 + P2 = +3.5 - 2.5 = +1.0 D. The focal length f = 1/P = 1/1.0 m = 1 m. Converted to centimeters, 1 meter is equal to 100 cm.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 11) The magnification for all the spherical mirrors is
For any spherical mirror (concave or convex), linear magnification m is defined as the ratio of the height of the image to the height of the object, which mathematically equates to m = -v/u.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 12) The mirror used as dentist mirror is
Dentists use concave mirrors because when the mirror is held very close to a tooth, it creates a magnified, erect, and virtual image, allowing the dentist to see fine details clearly.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 13) No matter how far you stand from a mirror your image appears erect the mirror is likely to be

Plane mirrors always form virtual, erect images of the same size. Convex mirrors always form virtual, erect images that are diminished in size. Because both always produce erect images regardless of distance, the mirror could be either type.

children.children: 14) When a light ray moves from denser to rarer medium it bends
When light travels from an optically denser medium into a rarer medium, its speed increases. This change in speed causes the light ray to refract and bend away from the normal line.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 15) What type of reaction occurs when copper is added to Dil. HCl
In the chemical reactivity series, copper is placed below hydrogen. Therefore, it is not reactive enough to displace hydrogen gas from dilute acids like hydrochloric acid.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 16) KCl(aq) + AgNO3(aq) -> AgCl(s) + KNO3(aq). The above reaction is an example of
The positive and negative ions switch places to form a solid precipitate (AgCl). This mutual exchange of ions is the defining characteristic of a double displacement reaction.

children.children: 17) Which of the following is an endothermic process
(d) dissolution of sodium hydroxide in water
An endothermic process requires the absorption of heat from the surroundings. Sublimation of dry ice requires heat energy to break the intermolecular bonds.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 18) Electrolysis of water is a decomposition reaction the ratio of volume of hydrogen and oxygen gases liberated during electrolysis of water is
The balanced chemical equation for its electrolysis is: 2H2O -> 2H2 + O2. This shows that two volumes of hydrogen gas are produced for every one volume of oxygen gas.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 19) Name of 2 metals which do not get corroded
Gold and platinum are highly unreactive noble metals. They sit at the very bottom of the reactivity series, meaning they do not readily react with oxygen, moisture, or other chemicals.

props.className: flex flex-col h-full justify-between shadow-2xl bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

children.children: 20) The colour of precipitate formed when you mix solution of lead (II)nitrate and potassium iodide

When colorless solutions of lead(II) nitrate and potassium iodide are mixed, they undergo a double displacement reaction to form lead(II) iodide, which crashes out as a striking, bright yellow precipitate.
